messages:
Jess: Hey @people-ops — had to book an emergency hotel on my personal card after the conference was canceled mid-night due to a building evacuation. Company card failed at the kiosk. Need to expense the hotel + per-diem for missed meals. I have the hotel folio, bank transaction, and a screenshot of the card decline. What’s the quickest path?

Li: Sorry that happened — hope you’re okay. For emergency bookings we reimburse personal-card charges: upload the hotel folio, the event cancellation proof (screenshot of the evacuation notice is fine), and the company-card decline screenshot. For per-diem we pro-rate based on partial day rules. @Finance Bot will do an expedited review if you mark it as "Emergency".

Alex: FYI — if there’s an event incident reference, include it (helps tagging). I think ops posted evac ref EVAC-2026-03-11. Also include the folio showing the nightly rate and taxes so finance can validate.

Jess: Attached screenshots in Expensify entry: hotel folio (FOLIO#8675309), bank txn for personal card, and kiosk decline screenshot. I also bought some bottled water/snacks (~$12) while waiting.

People Ops Bot: Quick checklist: 1) Upload all receipts to Expensify within 7 days; 2) Set policy = "Travel - Emergency Evac"; 3) Choose "Expedite: Emergency" for reimbursement routing. Finance will triage within 48 hours.

Maya: For per-diem: partial-day meal allowance applies for the evacuation day — submit per-diem claim or actual receipts for small items. Use the per-diem calculator: https://go.redwood/perdiem (pick the city and date). If you submit actual receipts for <$25 items we can reimburse those individually without per-diem.

Jess: Submitted to Expensify and tagged as "evac-hotel-03-11". Any chance to get an advance for taxi home? Company card is still with travel team.

Finance Bot: Expense 1987654321 received and flagged for expedited review. Please ensure your bank ACH details are in your finance profile for payout. If ACH isn't available for your country we’ll route via an off-cycle payroll deposit or virtual card.

Li: We’ll waive the standard 2-week processing for emergency cases. Finance to confirm payout method. If you need immediate cash, request petty cash from People Ops (regional limits apply).

Alex: Also logging an action to check the company card provider — we had a handful of kiosk declines last night.

Jess: One more question — two teammates and I were on the same folio. How should we split the hotel + per-diem?

Maya: Each teammate must file their own expense submission. If the folio lists only a single name, upload a brief note with the teammate names and the reservation confirmation email showing the room was shared. Finance will split charges pro-rata across submitters.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: receipts > $75 require vendor invoice. For foreign currency charges, finance converts using the exchange rate on the transaction date. Include the card transaction ID if possible.

Finance Bot: Expedited payout queued (ticket FIN-2026-0478). Expected arrival: ~48 hours depending on bank. If payout fails, we’ll notify you here.

Jess: Got it, thanks everyone. I'll follow up if anything else comes up. :thumbsup:
